Police (Take a Ride): up to 6 cars chase you (setting, 2..12; the vanilla Take a Ride sent only the patrol cars that happened to be near), a chase needs more felony (Chase Threshold: Classic / Relaxed / Lenient / Very Lenient, default Relaxed), light bumps, scaring pedestrians and property damage get a traffic stop on a clean record like speeding does (Pull-Over Offences: Extended), and the felony cools down by itself once the cops lost you (Felony Cool Down). New Police list in Options (main menu and pause menu).

Main menu: new Extras screen (Replays, HighScores, Secrets). Secrets is one list: Mountain pass, Race track and Bonus gallery (the original secret screens, available without earning them), toggles for invincibility, police immunity, player ghost, puppy dog cops, mini cars, Jericho mode and secret car, and Unlock Everything (all missions, cutscenes, secrets and secret cars, saves the profile). Options lost HighScores; Gameplay lost Controller and Vibration (Vibration moved to Controls, next to gamepad steering).

Performance: Options > Graphics > Car Detail Distance (cars farther than this use the low detail model; the biggest single saving in dense traffic, Max keeps 20000 units = 140 m of full detail cars), the 3D grass is drawn per 60 m block and only where it can be seen (GPU time of the grass -60 %), the whole frame copy into the PlayStation VRAM is skipped in the 3D game (about 0.25 ms per frame), environment lookups of the options are cached (every car and many per-frame checks did a slow getenv). New development tools: REDRIVER_SAMPLE (sampling profiler, tools\sampler_report.py), REDRIVER_GPUTIME / REDRIVER_GPUPASS (GPU timers), REDRIVER_CARSTAT.

Performance (second round): the cars are transformed once per vertex instead of once per triangle (the facing and depth tests are the same, checked on 11 million triangles), the lit car path is only used when there is a light, and a finished frame is presented while the next one is being built (one frame more latency, no wait for the GPU). In dense rush hour traffic at 1080p the game went from 176 to about 257 frames per second (99 % of the frames under the 165 fps budget). REDRIVER_NOFASTCARS=1 / REDRIVER_NODEFERPRESENT=1 switch the two back.
Level editor: light markers now work live (no reload needed); new SLOPE collision shape cuts a solid into slices so it follows a slanted wall or slab.
Level editor: GLOW button lights pieces at full brightness (always or blinking), for signs and windows at night.

Linux: the package carries a linux folder (python setup, movie converter built with cc) and redriver.sh (runs the game under Wine / Proton). Not tested on a real Linux system yet; see linux/README_LINUX.txt.

Setup: writes setup_report.txt every run (system details, results, full log). A disc it does not know or cannot use is analysed ONLY after asking (names, sizes, ids; no game data) into setup_disc_report.txt. Linux scripts write install_log.txt / launch_log.txt, linux/collect_report.sh packs them.
Water: the Chicago river, lake and sea are now an edit pack (mods/Chicago Water, 690 pieces) instead of generated by the game, so it can be changed in the level editor. Keep that pack enabled.

Fixed: with the free camera far from the city (north edge, over open water) the screen stayed black for about a minute; the sky and the GPU scene were drawn into the minimap's small draw area. Also fixed: the level editor froze when hundreds of original faces were taken (faces are now matched through a spatial index).
Fixed: restarting Take a Ride at night (or any restart while it is night) put a map picture on the tree billboards; the night texture swap wrote a special model page over the minimap / tree page.
Tail lamps: the whole red lens of a car's tail lamp now lights up when braking (and glows dimly with the lights on) instead of just a round blob in front of it.
Light options: Pause > Graphics > Light Cars / Light Lamps (how many cars / street lamps get real lights; up to 256 lights in all), every car on screen gets both headlight beams.

Car lights: brake lights and headlight glows no longer sink into the bodywork; headlights are two proper beams at the real lamp positions (the player's reach further) and now light the road ahead; each tail lamp lights the street behind the car.
Car reflections: added on top of the car texture (strong at grazing angles and in the windows) instead of mixed into it, so the paint keeps its colour and detail even at 100 %.
Day / night swap: the textures now cross fade into each other over a few seconds (both directions) instead of dipping to near black.

Fixed: after a restart at night the nearest buildings kept their night textures (dark walls, lit windows) once the day came; the day / night swap now also covers the texture pages that a restart un-flags.
Fixed: beach / sand patches of grass tiles got grass blades; blades now only grow on green textures (the batch cache version was raised: the first start rebuilds it).

Car reflections rebuilt: cars now reflect a live picture of the world around the player (the real sky with clouds and sun, the nearby buildings and road, day and night) instead of a painted skyline, with a soft Driver 1 style sheen and a sun glint. The paint keeps its own colour (the reflection adds sheen and mirrors at the edges and in glass instead of tinting the car). Costs about 0.05 ms of GPU time. Options > Tweaks > Car Reflect (a saved 0 keeps it off).

Mods can bring extra cars (mods/<name>/cars/index.txt + .d1c, made by tools/car2d1c.py from a car content mod); they appear in traffic in every city. New config key startCar (file name of a car): Take a Ride starts in it. New in Options > Gameplay Settings: Start Car, Start Car Paint (six paints for cars that have them) and Restart With This Car: pick any mod / Driver 1 car and its paint, then restart.
Level editor: animated textures (flip book): +FRAME adds the sampled texture as another frame, ANIM HZ sets the speed.

Traffic: fixed the heavy-traffic gridlock. Cars in slots 128-159 (only used above ~125 cars) never moved because their id was a signed byte; confused cars and parked cars that could not pull out no longer block lanes or pop out of existence; cars waiting for a gap to turn across traffic accept shorter gaps the longer they wait. Chicago with 150 cars: 32 % -> 79 % of the cars moving without the jam breaker, breaker removals down from 626 to about 60 in 2 minutes.

Traffic signals rebuilt: every signalled junction now serves ONE approach at a time (straight, right and left of that approach go together, everybody else is red), in turn: 15 s green, then amber during which nobody new may enter and the cars in the junction clear it (5 s, ini lightAmberSecs), then a short all red (lightClearSecs) and the next approach. All junctions share the clock and the lamps on the heads follow it. Opposite left turners and crossing traffic never move together any more (bench: near collisions between crossing cars at signals 12 -> 0 pair-seconds). Turning cars no longer stop half way across the junction, right turners no longer wait for a car standing in the opposite lane of the road they turn into, and parked cars beside the exit no longer block junctions. Cars no longer change lanes within about 2 s of a junction (neither before nor after it); turns are not affected.

Traffic and pedestrian density follow the time of day (ini [game] timeTraffic=1, 0 = always full): rush hour 16:00-18:00 is 95-100 % of the configured limits, 8:00 about 80 %, noon 75 %, midnight 35 %, 4:00 about 25 %. Extra cars are taken away one per second while nobody can see them; the limits come back as the clock moves on.

All four cities (Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas, Rio) are selectable in Take a Ride and the other free modes from the start (ini [game] unlockCities=1; 0 = only after the story missions like the original). Cars farther than carLodDistance (default 12000 units) use the low detail model: about 10 % more frames in dense traffic.

Main menu picture override: a PNG named mainmenu.png in a mod folder (or the game folder) replaces the main menu picture (any size, any aspect ratio, e.g. 16:9 or 21:9 with a new logo); see tools\mainmenu\README.txt.

Options reorganized (main menu and pause menu): Display (graphics preset Low / Medium / High / Max, window mode windowed / borderless / exclusive full screen, resolution, FPS limit 25 / 30 / 50 / 60 / 100 / 120 / 144 / 165 / 240 or unlimited, VSync), Graphics, Controls, Sound, Gameplay, Language, Mods. The display choices apply at once and are remembered in config\display.ini; the preset changes view distance, reflections, shadows, grass, lights and so on in one step (Custom when you changed a single value).

Controls can be rebound in both menus: Options > Controls > Keyboard Controls / Gamepad Controls (select a row and press the new key / button / trigger; Esc cancels, Del unbinds, Reset To Defaults). Kept in config\controls.ini on top of config.ini. The main menu has the same lists as the pause menu now.

Sound: the main menu Options > Sound is a list with SFX, music and radio volume and a sound mixer: your engine, traffic engines, horns and sirens, tyres and skids, collisions, ambience and weather, voices, pedestrians and footsteps (each 0-200 %, same list in the pause menu). The radio volume is remembered. Controls: Gamepad Steering Sensitivity slider (25-200 %).

New debug tool: F4 shows a label over every standing traffic car with the rule that holds it and a line to the car it waits for (timer top right, F10 saves a screenshot + the label log game\logs\trafficlabels.csv). F4 no longer changes the keyboard controller.
AI cars can drive to a destination (road aware, shared route data, no per-car planning; ambient traffic is untouched): auto-drive now drives to the waypoint you set on the map.

Extra cities (experimental): the four Driver 1 cities (San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami, New York 1978), converted to Driver 2 format by tools/d1level_to_d2.py from your own Driver 1 PC disc, can be dropped into <game or mod folder>\cities\<NAME>.LEV (+ .img map, .ini name / start / gas stations) and appear in Pause > Travel (Take a Ride) next to Chicago, Havana, Vegas and Rio (choosing one restarts the game into that city). They have the real streets, buildings, hills, civilian cars, traffic with lights, gas stations and a minimap, and the night uses the mod's night lighting. Not there yet: pedestrians, lit night windows, roadblocks, special cars, a loading picture per city.
New: languages

* Language option (pause > Options, Language): French, German, Italian, Spanish, Czech, Slovak, Polish, Hungarian, Russian, Greek, Turkish and Romanian (plus English). Everything the mod added is translatable (menus, HUD, jobs, CB radio, police stops, money / fuel texts), the speech subtitles and the credits headings too. Translation files are plain text in localizations\<language>\, see localizations\README.txt to add or improve a language.
* Texts are UTF-8 now; the HQ fonts and the HUD cover Latin (with Central European letters), Romanian comma letters, Greek and Cyrillic. Movie subtitles use the same fonts.

* The ~476 remaining speech subtitle lines of French, German, Italian, Spanish, Czech, Slovak, Polish and Hungarian are machine translated now (the cutscene lines are short sentence fragments, so some will read oddly): native speaker corrections are welcome, tools\loc\loc_report.py checks translations (see localizations\README.txt).
New: game and world

* Real water for Chicago's rivers and Lake Michigan (hand traced), at sea level, with the canal walls filled under the bridges and a planar reflection of the city in the water. Turn off with water=0 in config.ini.
* Flat roofs on the open-topped building models and courtyard roofs in the city blocks (roofs=0 in config.ini turns them off).

* 3D grass on the grass tiles, sun and moon shadows (buildings, trees, cars, posts, bins, lamps), real sun / moon positions for Chicago with phases, a smooth day / night texture swap, Chicago day missions start at 4 PM.
* Dynamic lights without bleeding through walls; translucent shadows depth tested.
* Physics Speed option (pause > Options > Gameplay): NTSC (30 Hz, default) or PAL (25 Hz, slower). Mission timers keep counting real seconds in both.
* Free camera (F7) and high views draw the whole city; the horizon fog thins out with camera height.
* Bridges, the ferris wheel, trains, ferries and helicopters are now drawn from far away (they vanished beyond about 15000 units).

* Trees, bushes and signs are drawn by the graphics card across the whole view distance (baked like the buildings and turned to face the camera by the shader). They used to be drawn by the CPU only within 36 cells and popped out of existence beyond that; the CPU saves about half a millisecond per frame, which helps older processors. Animated lights of distant objects keep animating.
* The adaptive CPU draw ring now counts sprites as well as buildings when it decides how many cells the processor draws live.
New: maps and HUD

* Brand new in-game map: pre-rendered whole-world map with road names that follow the roads, regions, gas stations, zoom and pan (keys and stick), waypoints, and a rotating minimap with road names, pumps and a street name popup. The minimap zoom is an option.

* New 70s styled HUD pieces: speedometer / tachometer, fuel, damage and wanted arcs that glow when they change, clock, input hints (CRUISE = the old Auto-Drive, MAP), job offer cards, pause menu panels.
* Input icons: keyboard keys (square plates) or gamepad buttons (round pills), 5 icon themes, PS4 / PS5 / Standard / Xbox packs.
* The pause menu panels show key / button hints underneath (up/down select, Enter / cross OK, Esc / triangle back).
* Speech subtitles (cutscenes and mission speech) use the HUD font on a soft plate, larger, wrapped, and correct for every language.
* Hint pills fit their text in every language; the minimap compass sits on the rim; the map picture is dull like the original.
* In-game console (the ` key) replaces the old console window: engine log, commands (help, lang, fps, pos, time, verbose, quit).
New: level editor (F6)

* An in-game editor with a 70s panel and mouse control: edit / hide / replace original faces, add quads, boxes, polygons, prisms and OBJ imports, custom TGA textures (16 / 256 colours / direct colour), groups, arrays, undo / redo, autosave, bookmarks and an in-game manual. Pieces can be solid (traffic and pedestrians steer around them) and ground pieces are drivable (ramps, platforms). Also: align / spread, a measure tool, a triangle budget meter, 400 undo steps, placeable copies of the level's own models (lamp posts, signs, barrels ...), spinning pieces, and gameplay markers (zones, checkpoint laps, spawn points, lights). Edits are saved into edit packs (folders of mods\, default Level Edits): switch, start, merge, archive or SHARE (zip) a pack in the editor, with its own object library, and every enabled mod's edits are applied as locked layers, so edit packs stack and switch on / off in Options > Mods. Works on every level.
New: setup, folders and tools
* Mods can now also bring tweaks (tweaks.ini), a HUD colour theme (hud\theme.ini), taxi passenger talk (fares\fares.txt) and package jobs (jobs\jobs.txt); see mods\README.txt.

* Mod list in the options menu (Options > Mods): switch mods on / off and change their load order; mod.json gives a mod a name, version, author, description and requirements. Order and switches are kept in config\mods.ini.

* Old installs are migrated: when you unpack this version over an old one, the old DRIVER2 / d1cars / install / maps / icons / carsounds folders are moved into GAME_DATA and mods\ReDriver Core (nothing is overwritten or deleted), and the disc image path in config.ini follows.
* The setup converts the PlayStation movies itself (no Java), about a minute, 0.7 GB instead of 1.3 GB.

* New folder layout: GAME_DATA, config\ (settings), logs\ (all logs), cache\ (generated files, safe to delete), mods\ReDriver Core, radio stations inside the game folder; settings from older versions are migrated. The exe is named reDriver2_extended.exe, window title "reDriver 2: Extended", with an application icon; the shipped exe is stripped (3 MB).
* FontTool (game\tools\FontTool) builds the HQ fonts for more languages.
Faster

* Level loading is quicker: the baked level geometry is cached on disk (cache\batch_*.bin, first start writes it, later starts read it), the 0.7 s save wait at every start and the controller haptic probe are gone. Chicago loads about a second faster.
* Adaptive CPU draw ring, GPU batches for static buildings and ground tiles, region culling, render interpolation.
Fixed
* Physics Speed (PAL): job and CB timers, police stop timers, fuel use, the pump rate, the day clock and the speedometer follow the real tick rate, so a second stays a second in both modes.
* The in-game console no longer lists harmless messages (no haptics, waiting for the disc read).
* Mission cinematics: ground, walls and cutscene cars vanished in parts (old depth / stencil data of the previous frame survived).
* The ferris wheel and other animated events disappeared at distance.
* Cutscene subtitles and the credits use the HQ font for all letters; no more '?' for accented or Cyrillic letters in menus.

* "CdSearchFile called while in CdlReadS" console spam; missing-glyph warnings; lifting bridges at distance; night textures after a restart; tree texture squares at night; far building fronts missing; shadows visible through buildings.
* Fixed a rare crash (division by zero in the angle code) when far-away objects were drawn.

changelog.title: 0.2.0-beta   (first complete public beta package)
intro: Everything from the 0.1.x test builds below, in one package, plus a polished setup and docs.
New / improved since 0.1
* Setup (reDriver_Setup.exe): a guided console setup that explains each step and gives hints; asks for BOTH Driver 2 discs up front;
recognizes the disc release (USA, Europe, France, Germany, Italy, Spain) and sets the game language; offers retry when the wrong
disc is picked; shows progress; ends with a summary and writes setup_log.txt for bug reports.
* Cutscene and mission audio (voices + music) is decoded from your disc by the setup (cutscenes were silent before).
* Optional movie conversion (needs Java), including the disc 2 movies for Vegas and Rio.
* Setup can reuse the cutscene audio / movies another REDRIVER2 build already extracted (--import).
* Driver 1 (PlayStation) cars and the 30 PC-only cars (Driver 1 PC disc: Ferrari 250 SWB, Thunderbird ...) are converted from your discs.
* Car sounds: Driver 1 cars use the Driver 1 engine sound; 16 engine sound types shipped (carsounds folder) and any number of
your own sets can be added and assigned in carsounds\sounds.txt. Driver 2 cars keep their original sounds unless you change that.
* Mods folder: drop REDRIVER2 content mods (texture packs, car packs) into  mods\  - nothing is overwritten, they follow the day /
night cycle and the whole-map textures. See mods\README.txt.
* Controls: keyboard keys for everything that was gamepad-only (T auto-drive, M map, Y / N CB jobs, , and . radio); LB / RB change
the radio station on pads without a D-pad; on-screen hints show keyboard keys or gamepad buttons depending on what you use;
pause menu > Options > Controller Settings lists all controls; keyboard walking works with a controller connected (Steam Input etc.).
* Version number in the pause menu. The X/Y/Z position display is off by default.
* log.txt (previous run: log_prev.txt) with system, graphics, performance and crash information; F10 marks a problem with a
screenshot; collect_report.bat packs everything for a bug report.
* Windows 7 / 8 and 32-bit Windows: 32-bit game and setup, Universal C Runtime installer included.
Fixed
* Whole-screen flicker on some frames (water-only frame) - the frame is now presented in one piece.
* Silent cutscene cars no longer have working headlights / exhaust smoke; CB job popups only appear in free roam.
* Texture mods were overwritten by the day / night swap and ignored on the distant city pages.
* Garbage textures on some Driver 1 / PC cars; wheel positions of tall vans.
Known issues: see README.txt.
